mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the sensory and motor fibres was most worthwhile: the picture clarified that signals travel in opposite directions through separate fibres within one nerve.

leastWorthwhile.text: Protecting the brain and spinal cord felt a little repetitive because both pairings were predictable, even though the side openings for nerves were useful to see.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the spinal cord can produce a rapid response without waiting for a conscious decision.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. I followed the offered sensory and motor pairing without knowing exactly how the routes would join, but the result explained it.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the nervous system controls movement. The separate signal routes made me curious, though several choices here were straightforward.
